fun_facts: Brock Bowers is from Napa, California.
As a true freshman in 2021, Brock Bowers led Georgia in catches (56), receiving yards (882), and receiving touchdowns (13).
Brock Bowers helped Georgia win two national titles.
Brock Bowers became the first two-time winner of the John Mackey Award, given to college football’s top tight end.
Brock Bowers became the first rookie tight end to reach 100 catches in a season, and the third rookie tight end to reach 1,000 receiving yards.
Brock Bowers caught 13 passes in one game, setting the NFL record for most receptions in a game by a rookie tight end.

excerpts:
[Georgia](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/61/georgia-bulldogs) junior [Brock Bowers](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4432665/brock-bowers) , the first two-time winner of the Mackey Award as the top tight end in college football, announced Tuesday that he's entering the NFL draft.

Bowers, a native of Napa, California, is [ranked as the No. 5 prospect available](https://www.espn.com/nfl/draft2024/insider/story/_/id/38381720/2024-nfl-draft-rankings-mel-kiper-big-board-top-prospects-position-best-players
citations.title: Georgia star TE Brock Bowers declares for 2024 NFL draft - ESPN

excerpts:
[Brock Bowers](https://www.nfl.com/players/brock-bowers/) ’ first-year tour de force has hit more history.

Bowers became only the third rookie tight end in NFL chronicle to record 1,000 receiving yards, accomplishing the feat during Sunday's [19-14 win](https://www.nfl.com/games/jaguars-at-raiders-2024-reg-16) over the Jacksonville Jaguars.

Bowers hauled in a 32-yard pass from quarterback [Aidan O'Connell](https://www.nfl.com/players/aidan-o-connell) in the first quarter to reach 1,000, becoming the first 2024 rookie pass catcher to hit the mark this season, as well. In the fourth quarter, Bowers caught his 10th pass of the game and his 100th for the season, becoming the first rookie tight end to reach the mark.
citations.title: Raiders' Brock Bowers becomes third rookie TE to eclipse 1,000 yards, first to hit 100 catches | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com

# Brock Bowers & Braden Fiske Named November Rookies of the Month

Awards Rookies of the Month November Football Communications Las Vegas Raiders Los Angeles Rams

Dec 05, 2024

Share

**  
NEW YORK —** **Dec. 5, 2024** — Las Vegas tight end **Brock Bowers** and Los Angeles Rams defensive end **Braden Fiske** are the NFL Rookies of the Month for games played in the month of November.

**OFFENSE : TE BROCK BOWERS, LAS VEGAS RAIDERS**

* Bowers led all rookies in receiving yards (349), receptions (32), receiving yards per game (87.3) and receiving touchdowns (three) in November. In Week 11, he had 13 receptions for 126 yards and a touchdown, the most receptions by a rookie tight end in a game in NFL history. Bowers recorded his third game with at least 10 receptions in Week 13 and joined Odell Beckham Jr.
